name: Phase 1 — Chant phonemes at body points
nyasa_meaning: Reconstructing the biological body as the body of Śakti by installing the matrix from which articulated experience arises.
breath_policy: Natural breath. Phonation may lengthen exhale. Do not force ratios. TĀ 4.91 — do not torment the body.
principle: Totalization — fill the body with the alphabet a→kṣa from head/sensory → limbs → torso → internal constituents. Don't invent physiology the texts don't claim.

steps.label: Seat + Flood frame (1 min)
steps.detail: Spine long. Intention: 'I am installing the phonemic matrix on this body as a tradition-inscribed practice, not as anatomy.' Read one line: ordinary body → mapped body → mantra-body → deity-body → cosmos-body.

steps.label: Natural breath + voice readiness (2 min)
steps.detail: 5–10 easy breaths. Soften jaw. Feel that speech will ride prāṇa. No ratio forcing.

steps.label: Vowels on head/face — chant + touch (8 min)
for_each: Touch locus lightly with right hand
Optional: note PTV power name as secondary layer only
steps.short_variant: If time short: a · ā · i · ī · aṃ · aḥ only

steps.label: ka-varga — right upper limb (4 min)
steps.mouth: Feel velar closure back of mouth. Manner: plain stop → wind → glow → glow+wind → nasal tunnel.
steps.detail: Chant each phoneme once while touching its tantric locus. Then chant the five as one arc without stopping — continuous right-arm trajectory.

steps.label: ca-varga — left upper limb (4 min)
steps.mouth: Palate. Tongue blade. Same manner ladder.
steps.detail: Mirror of ka-varga. Then both vargas: right arc then left arc on natural breath.

steps.label: ṭa-varga + ta-varga — lower limbs (4 min)
steps.detail: Retroflex right lower limb; dental left lower limb. Chant + touch. If too long, do one varga only.

steps.label: pa-varga + deep constituents (3 min)
steps.detail: Shorten if needed: pa-pha-ba-bha-ma then ha kṣa. Heart (ma) gets longer pause.

steps.label: Totalization pass — full a→kṣa once (5 min)
steps.detail: One continuous chant through the full Mātṛkā order (vowels then consonants). Touch optional. Goal: body feels filled as a field, not as disconnected points. End on silence at crown/tongue (aṃ / aḥ).

steps.label: aham contraction (3 min)
steps.detail: Stop chanting. Natural breath. Mentally: a (forehead/emergence) → ha (terminal edge / prāṇa) → ṃ (bindu, crown). Let a…kṣa field contract toward aham. Rest in reflexive 'I'. Then if it rises, let a…kṣa expand again once. This is the master rhythm — not occult collecting.

steps.label: Silence / recognition seed (2 min)
steps.detail: No manipulation. One recognition question only: are the phonemic locations mechanisms outside me, or expressions of the awareness that is installing them? Don't answer philosophically — feel. Stop always available.

steps.label: One-line log
steps.detail: phase | which install completed | easiest locus | totalization felt? y/n | any tension

progression_after: Phase 2 — dual-coordinate objects + random locate drill
